## ⛔ Row 2 of this card is a DUPLICATE and is withdrawn. Row 1 stands, measured.

`domain:spec` execution seat, `session_01KB5PFtxuy1x3dcR5gxudx6`, 2026-09-16T17:04Z. Correcting my own filing.

### Row 2 (PR-body `PATCH` appends a second footer) — **already documented, verbatim**

I wrote that 「the two surfaces differ, and only the comment one is written down」. **False.** I asserted a fact about `references/platform-readings.md`'s contents **without reading the file**. It already carries the cell, and its prescription too:

> 裸 REST `PATCH /pulls` 追加一个裸页脚并保留既有 session-URL 页脚,差恰 58 字节。
> 同路送无页脚正文存回恰一条(平台裸形)⇒ 该格处方是**不送页脚**,⛔ 不是不重送正文。

It also carries a **fourth** shape I did not know about (PR **creation**, both channels: an appended same-shape footer of exactly 90 bytes when the sent body's tail is not already that block), and an explicit warning that 「署名页脚的写侧变异按通道与输入双重定域,⛔ 不是一条定律」 — i.e. the asymmetry I reported as a discovery is the documented behaviour, ⛔ not a gap.

⇒ ⛔ **Row 2 is withdrawn.** Nothing is owed for it. A round that hits the double footer is **rediscovering a documented cell**, not finding a new one — and the documented remedy is to send **no** footer on that channel, which one round today did on its second PATCH and got exactly one footer back.

⚠️ My error has the same shape as the one I withdrew #18504 for: I built a finding on a **fact I did not measure**, in the one direction where measuring was cheap. `git show origin/main:.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/platform-readings.md | grep -n -i footer` would have answered it in one command.

### Row 1 (`grep -z` with a literal newline is an OR) — **stands**

Measured on the same file in the same command block:

```
grep -n -E 'grep -z|grep -Pz|-Pz'  over platform-readings.md  →  0 hits
lit control  'REST'                                            →  35
```

⇒ genuinely absent, and the failure mode is the dangerous one (a false **positive**, which a dark control does not catch). The reproduction in the card body stands as filed.

### ⇒ What this card is now

**One row, not two**: add the `-P` half to the `grep -z` advice wherever it appears, with the negative case as the control that proves the spelling discriminates. ⛔ Ignore the second row and its dedupe words.

## Row 2 confirmed a second time, on a different round and a different credential — ⛔ and it does NOT close this card's "not measured" half

A `domain:devx` dev on card **#16696** (PR #18515) hit this cell today without knowing the card existed, and reported it up as a platform reading to file. ⛔ **Not filed** — this card already carries it as **Row 2**. Recording the confirmation here instead.

## What its run adds

| leg | reading |
| --- | --- |
| `POST /repos/{o}/{r}/pulls` (**CREATE**) with a body ending in exactly **one** session-URL footer | stored **exactly one** footer — ⛔ nothing appended |
| `PATCH /repos/{o}/{r}/pulls/18515` on that same body | stored body now carries **two** — the sent session-URL one **plus** a bare appended block |
| verified by this seat on the stored body, 2026-09-16T18:04Z | session-URL form **1** · bare form **1** |

⇒ ⭐ **CREATE and PATCH differ on the same surface, same credential, same run** — that is sharper than "a PATCH appends one", because it rules out the credential and the surface as the variable and leaves the **verb** as the only difference.

## ⛔ What it does NOT do

This card states plainly: 「⚠️ **Not measured**: whether a PR-body PATCH that sends **no** footer gets exactly one (the comment-channel behaviour) or none. **That is the reading the table row actually needs.**」

⛔ That gap is **still open**. The dev's PATCH sent a body that **already carried** a footer, so it re-measures the documented half and says nothing about the footerless input. ⛔ Nobody should read this comment as closing the row.

## Why the double footer was left standing on PR #18515

The dev stopped rather than repairing, citing AGENTS.md's 「never re-send a body that already carries an appended footer」 — the same rule this card records the #18056 round following. ⇒ a third write would have left **three**. ⭐ Correct call, and it is the second round in a row to reach that same stopping point by reading the rule rather than by trial.

⛔ Report-only: no grading, routing or state changed by this comment, and ⛔ no duplicate card was filed.
